summary: Sheridan County rock on the Bighorn NF where CCC crews built a fire tower of unknown date; it is now a day hike with no readable source on remains.

facts.status_note: Listed among unknown/undocumented sites; no readable source confirms a standing tower.

access.note: Listed as a day hike with trailhead directions in Sheridan County's guide of favorite hikes.

visit.trail_note: 1.7 miles round trip, moderate with steep sections; 360-degree views from the top.

notes_for_editor: The built fact rests on a CCC accomplishments list for the Bighorn NF in the Wyoming NRHP continuation sheet (p. 152); the sheet gives no date, so no 'built' event with a year is recorded. The Living New Deal page (livingnewdeal.org, 'Steamboat Point Fire Lookout Tower (demolished)') returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text and I did not cite it; its demolished/not-extant claim is therefore unverified in our cache and should be checked before it is published. Search snippets from onlyinyourstate.com and a trail site mention wooden posts and a concrete footer at the summit; the onlyinyourstate page returned 403 and the trail page did not confirm it, so the story says no readable source describes remains. Staffing is not in any readable source. The brief's agency (Bighorn National Forest) is confirmed by the westlookouts page. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the day-hike sentence is now backed by the guide's 'favorite day hikes' wording, and the NRHP document is named as a continuation sheet to match its title. Story is about 250 words.
